title: No pending-walk draft recovery banner (web walk-drafts), and R16 session identity not persisted
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/walks/page.tsx:128-136,212-312 (recovery and discard), 405-415 (store draft before createWalk), 498-518 (banner); apps/web/src/lib/walk-drafts.ts
ios_ref: apps/ios/app/(tabs)/walks.tsx (absent); apps/ios/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:162-200 (handleSave: createWalk, error phase only); apps/ios/src/lib/walk-tracking-service.ts:42 (only the BG GPS accumulator is persisted)
current_ios: iOS keeps no local copy of a finished walk. If createWalk fails (e.g. a rules rejection or the app is killed while the 'saving' phase waits on an offline ack), the only trace is an error string inside the tracking modal. Closing it loses the session. The home page has no pending/retry/discard UI.
target: Same behaviour as web: finished tracked walks are stored locally under a per-uid, per-walkId key before writing, removed once the server acks, listed on the walks home as a status banner with retry and per-draft discard (with confirm), and retried when the app returns to the foreground.
fix_plan: 1) New apps/ios/src/lib/walk-drafts.ts: an AsyncStorage port of the web module with the same key prefixes 'mango.walks.pending.v1.{uid}.{walkId}' and 'mango.walks.discarded.v1.{uid}.{walkId}'. Async versions of store/remove/discard/wasDiscarded/list (use AsyncStorage.getAllKeys + multiGet). Serialise startedAt/endedAt as ISO strings and the CreateWalkInput fields except scorePet: store petId plus the score inputs, or store the precomputed score and pass it through. 2) walk-tracking-view.tsx handleSave: if wasDiscarded, throw t('Walks.core.draftDiscarded'); call storeWalkDraft before createWalk and removeWalkDraft after success. 3) walks.tsx: keep `pendingDrafts` state; load it on focus and on AppState→'active' (the retry hint, since NetInfo is not installed). Render a banner above the top bar: View with radius.lg, 1px hairline, bg colors.cardSoft (or the equivalent mango-card-soft token), padding 16, role status. Text t('Walks.core.pendingRecovery',{count}). If there is an error, show t('Walks.core.saveFailed') or t('Walks.core.discardDraftFailed'). Add a pill Button: recovering ? t('Walks.core.savingWalk') : t('Error.retry'). Note: web uses tC('retry') but Common.retry does not exist in either catalog; Error.retry exists in zh and en. Add one row per draft: `${petName} · ${startedAt.toLocaleString()}` plus a secondary pill t('Walks.core.discardDraft') that confirms via Alert (title Walks.core.discardDraftTitle, body discardDraftBody, destructive). Serialise recovery with an in-flight ref, as web does, so foreground events never run parallel writes. Render the banner in the 0-pet branch too (web page.tsx:525).

title: Guests get the auto-photo-share prompt; web skips it because guests cannot post
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/walks/page.tsx:429-441 (`autoPhotoEnabled && !isGuest`), 882-888 (`open={startPromptOpen && !isGuest}`)
current_ios: handleStartWalking checks only `autoPhotoShare`, so an anonymous (guest) user gets the START photo prompt and composer, and WalkTrackingView receives autoPhotoShare={autoPhotoShare}, so the END prompt fires too. Posting is a community action guests cannot complete.
target: Guests skip both prompts and go straight into tracking, as on web.
fix_plan: In walks.tsx: `const { user } = useAuth(); const isGuest = !!user?.isAnonymous; const canAutoShare = autoPhotoShare && !isGuest;` Use canAutoShare in handleStartWalking and pass `autoPhotoShare={canAutoShare}` to WalkTrackingView. This is the same isGuest pattern settings.tsx:34 uses.

title: Refreshing right after a save double-counts today's minutes on the done/recap screen
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/walks/page.tsx:416-418 (tracked saves deliberately do not refresh while recap is open), 839-846 (refresh on close)
current_ios: walks.tsx passes onSaved={data.refresh}. The tracking view calls onSaved() right after createWalk and then stays open (phase 'done' plus the END share prompt) when autoPhotoShare is on. The refresh brings back walks that include the new one, so the `todayMinBefore` prop (todayProgress.minutes) now contains it, and blendedMin = todayMinBefore + doneMin counts the walk twice in the recap's percent and remaining minutes. If the pets read fails during that refresh, activePet becomes null under the open share flow.
target: Same as web: refresh the home data only when the tracking overlay closes.
fix_plan: In walks.tsx, pass `onSaved={() => { savedRef.current = true; }}` (or a no-op) and `onClose={() => { setSessionOpen(false); setPendingWalkId(''); void data.refresh(); }}`. Alternative: in walk-tracking-view.tsx, snapshot todayMinBefore into a ref when the session starts (in the `visible` effect) and use that snapshot for blendedMin.

title: Stop/save flow is a pre-save summary with unconfirmed 捨棄 and auto-close; web saves immediately and shows a post-save recap with retry/discard-draft + back/leaderboard CTAs
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:543-567 (finishWalk freezes input + saves immediately), 599-641 (saveWalkOnce/ensureWalkSavedOnce single in-flight promise, then onUpdate patch loop for notes/photos), 893-896 (savingWalk/walkNotSaved headline before saved), 1077-1114 (saveError + Retry + Discard draft only when !saved, status line, 回到遛狗 / 查看排行榜 CTAs disabled until saved); apps/web/src/lib/firebase/walks.ts:174-179 updateWalkDetails
current_ios: Stop goes to a done screen that has NOT saved anything; user must tap 儲存 (flat brand pill, white text) or 捨棄. 捨棄 (line 397-405) calls onClose immediately with no confirmation, silently throwing away the whole walk (data-loss on a mis-tap). On save failure the whole screen is replaced by a full-screen '存檔失敗' page whose only action is 返回. After a successful save the view closes immediately (or after the END share flow) so the user never sees a saved recap, and there is no 查看排行榜 path.
target: Match web: on confirmed stop, freeze the walk input and save immediately; done screen shows status (savingWalk → walkSaved), recap, notes; notes/photos patched afterward via update; on failure show inline saveFailed + Retry + (only if not yet saved) Discard draft with a confirm; bottom CTAs 回到遛狗 (primary gradient) and 查看排行榜 (secondary), disabled while saving/uploading/unsaved.
fix_plan: 1) apps/ios/src/lib/walks.ts: add `export async function updateWalkDetails(walkId: string, details: { notes: string | null; photoURLs: string[] })` → `firestore().collection('walks').doc(walkId).update(details)` (rules already allow walker updates limited to notes/photoURLs, firestore.rules:345-348). 2) In walk-tracking-view.tsx replace Phase with `'tracking' | 'done'` plus `saving`, `saved`, `saveError` state. Add refs: `stoppedInputRef` (CreateWalkInput frozen at stop: startedAt from final.startedAt, endedAt = new Date() at stop, distance/duration/path, petId/petName/familyId/scorePet/streakDays snapshot), `savePromiseRef`, `savedDetailsRef` (JSON of {notes, photoURLs} last persisted). 3) `ensureSaved()` mirrors web ensureWalkSavedOnce: if no in-flight promise, run: if not saved → createWalk(stoppedInput) then setSaved(true); then loop while JSON(detailsRef.current) !== savedDetailsRef.current → updateWalkDetails(walkId, details). Catch → setSaveError(t('Walks.core.saveFailed')). 4) finishWalk(final) after stop confirm → setPhase('done'); stoppedInputRef = ...; void ensureSaved(). 5) Notes TextInput onBlur → void ensureSaved(); photo upload completion when saved → void ensureSaved(). 6) Replace save/discard block (lines 380-405) with: `{saveError && <Text style={errorText} accessibilityRole='alert'>{saveError}</Text>}`, `{saveError && <Button label={t('Error.retry')} pill onPress={ensureSaved} disabled={saving} />}`, `{saveError && !saved && <Button variant='secondary' pill label={t('Walks.core.discardDraft')} onPress={confirmDiscard} />}` where confirmDiscard uses Alert.alert(t('Walks.core.discardDraftTitle'), t('Walks.core.discardDraftBody'), [{text:t('Common.cancel'),style:'cancel'},{text:t('Walks.core.discardDraft'),style:'destructive',onPress:...}]); a status Text (12pt, colors.ink2, centered) showing uploading→t('Walks.photo.uploading') / saving→t('Walks.core.savingWalk') / saved→t('Walks.core.walkSaved'); then `<Button size='lg' fullWidth label={t('Walks.core.backToWalking')} onPress={async()=>{ if(await ensureSaved()) onClose(); }} disabled={saving||uploading||!saved} />` and `<Button size='lg' variant='secondary' fullWidth label={t('Walks.core.viewLeaderboard')} onPress={async()=>{ if(await ensureSaved()){ onClose(); router.push('/(tabs)/leaderboard'); } }} />`. Wrap the CTA column in maxWidth 320 (web max-w-xs). 7) Headline: when !saved show centered 18pt/700 ink text savingWalk/walkNotSaved instead of the celebration (web 893-896); render goal-hit/missed headline only when saved. 8) Delete the `phase === 'error'` full-screen branch (231-242).

title: Manual pause / resume missing (service + UI)
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/walk-tracking.ts:183-207 (pause/resume, pausedMs subtraction), 452-456 (samples ignored while paused); apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:528-534, 852-864 (secondary pill Pause/Play + Walks.core.pause/resume), 700-707 (pill flips to 已暫停, dot stops pulsing)
current_ios: No pause control. WalkTrackingService has no pause()/resume(); isPaused only means 'backgrounded in foreground-fallback mode' and in background mode the clock and GPS run until stop.
target: Secondary pill button (Pause/Play lucide icon + 暫停/繼續) above the stop button; pausing freezes duration and distance; status pill shows 已暫停 with a static dot.
fix_plan: Service: add `pausedMs` and `pausedSince` (persist both in the AsyncStorage bgSession, see TRACK-7) and a `userPaused` flag in state (keep isPaused semantics = user pause; move the fallback-background notion into a new `backgrounded?: boolean` field). `pause()`: if tracking && !paused → pausedSince=Date.now(); bgSession.paused=true; persistBgSession(); update({isPaused:true}). `resume()`: pausedMs += now-pausedSince; pausedSince=null; bgSession.paused=false; persist; update({isPaused:false}). In tick()/stop() subtract `pausedMs + (pausedSince? now-pausedSince : 0)` from elapsed. In handleFix() and in the headless task `ingestLocations` early-return when paused (task reads bgSession.paused after hydrate). View: add `<Pressable style={pauseBtn} onPress={()=> state.isPaused ? svc.resume() : svc.pause()}>` with `{state.isPaused ? <Play size={16} color={colors.ink}/> : <Pause size={16} color={colors.ink}/>}` + Text t(state.isPaused ? 'Walks.core.resume' : 'Walks.core.pause'); style: height 40, paddingHorizontal 20, borderRadius radius.pill, backgroundColor colors.card, hairline border, 14pt/500 ink (web Button secondary h-10 rounded-full px-5 text-sm font-medium). Place it in the same column as stop (gap 12, maxWidth 320).

title: No confirmation before stopping a walk
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:509-526 (askConfirm stopConfirmTitle/Body/Yes, danger, re-entrancy guard)
current_ios: Tapping 停止 immediately stops GPS and ends the session; an accidental tap in a pocket ends the walk.
target: Confirm dialog '結束這次散步？' / '確認後會儲存並結束這次散步。' with 取消 and destructive '結束散步'.
fix_plan: In handleStop: guard with `stopConfirmRef`; call `Alert.alert(t('Walks.core.stopConfirmTitle'), t('Walks.core.stopConfirmBody'), [{ text: t('Common.cancel'), style: 'cancel', onPress: release }, { text: t('Walks.core.stopConfirmYes'), style: 'destructive', onPress: () => { const f = svc.stop(); finishWalk(f); } }], { cancelable: true, onDismiss: release })`. Alert.alert is already the confirm pattern used across iOS (post-menu, settings).

title: Live today-progress bar (stored + current session vs goal) missing during tracking
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:664-671 (WalkSession.blendTodayProgress), 722-746 (todayPercent label left, '{min} / {goal} min' right, 8px rounded-full track mango-hairline, fill mango-amber → mango-leaf at 100%, role=progressbar)

title: R16: start failure (and pre-permission state) still shows '● 記錄中'; start() result ignored; reset during pending start leaks location updates
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/walk-tracking.ts:116-124, 290-323 (unsupported/denied stop tracking and surface errorKind); walk-tracking-view.tsx:692 (tracking UI only rendered when state exists), 748-760
current_ios: The view only branches on errorKind === 'permission_denied'. If startLocationUpdatesAsync/watchPositionAsync throws, state becomes isTracking:false/position_unavailable but the UI still shows '● 記錄中' with a frozen 00:00 timer and the stop button saves a 0-min walk. While the permission prompts are pending (INITIAL state, isTracking:false) the UI also already claims 記錄中. If the overlay closes while start() is awaiting permission, reset() runs first and start() then begins location updates + ticker with no owner.
target: Explicit tracking state: 'starting' (spinner, no recording copy), 'tracking', 'start_failed' (message + Retry + Back), 'permission_denied'; no orphaned location sources.
fix_plan: Service: add a `generation` counter; start() captures gen and after each await checks `if (gen !== this.generation) { await this.stopLocationSource(); return false; }`; reset() increments generation. Add `status: 'idle'|'starting'|'tracking'|'failed'` to WalkTrackingState (set 'starting' before permission requests, 'tracking' after the source starts, 'failed' in the catch at 211-215). View: `useEffect` → `void svc.start().then(ok => { if (!ok && mounted) ... })`; render branches: status==='starting' → centered ActivityIndicator + t('Walks.core.tracking') muted; errorKind==='permission_denied' → existing permission screen (i18n per TRACK-20); status==='failed' → centered AlertTriangle (lucide) + t('Walks.core.startFailed') + Button t('Error.retry') (calls svc.start()) + secondary t('Common.back') (onClose). Only render the tracking body when status==='tracking' or (stopped & phase done). Disable stop when status!=='tracking'.
needs_new_i18n_keys: Walks.core.startFailed = 無法開始定位，請確認定位服務已開啟後再試一次。 | Couldn't start location tracking. Check that Location Services are on and try again.

title: R16: active walk session identity not persisted — app kill/relaunch loses the walk and can leave background location running with no UI
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/walk-drafts.ts:11-54 (per-uid/walkId keyed persistence, discard markers); walks/page.tsx:212-290 (recovery on mount/reconnect)
current_ios: Only the GPS accumulator + startedAt are persisted (mango.walk.bgSession.v1) — no uid, walkId, petId, familyId, pausedMs. sessionOpen/pendingWalkId live in React state. If iOS evicts the app mid-walk, relaunch shows the walks home with no active session; nothing calls Location.hasStartedLocationUpdatesAsync, so the headless task can keep recording (blue location bar) indefinitely and the stale AsyncStorage entry is never cleared or used.
target: Persist the full session identity; on WalksScreen mount detect an in-progress session (stored record and/or hasStartedLocationUpdatesAsync) and offer Continue (reopen tracking view hydrated from bgSession) or End & save (build a draft from the stored accumulator and go to the done screen). If the record belongs to another uid, stop updates and drop it.
fix_plan: 1) Extend BgSession to `{ v:2, uid, walkId, petId, petName, familyId, startedAt, pausedMs, pausedSince, paused, backgroundMode, acc }`; WalkTrackingService.start(identity) receives these and persists before starting updates (also in foreground-fallback mode, persist on each accepted fix throttled ~5s). 2) Export `getActiveWalkSession(): Promise<BgSession|null>` (hydrate + `Location.hasStartedLocationUpdatesAsync(BG_LOCATION_TASK)`) and `WalkTrackingService.resume(session)` which re-attaches the ticker without resetting acc/startedAt. 3) walks.tsx: on focus (useFocusEffect) when not sessionOpen, call getActiveWalkSession(); if uid !== user.uid → stopLocationUpdatesAsync + clear; else Alert.alert(t('Walks.core.resumeActiveTitle'), t('Walks.core.resumeActiveBody'), [Continue → setPendingWalkId(s.walkId); open tracking view in resume mode; End → open tracking view directly in done phase with the stored final state (uses TRACK-1 save path)]). 4) Clear the record on successful save or confirmed discard. Requires real-device verification of OS relaunch (per review note).
needs_new_i18n_keys: Walks.core.resumeActiveTitle = 有一趟散步還在記錄中 | A walk is still in progress
Walks.core.resumeActiveBody = 要繼續這次散步，還是結束並儲存？ | Continue this walk, or end and save it?
Walks.core.resumeActiveContinue = 繼續散步 | Continue walk

title: No local draft / recovery for stopped-but-unsaved walks; offline save leaves the UI stuck on a spinner
web_ref: apps/web/src/app/app/walks/page.tsx:390-422 (storeWalkDraft before createWalk, removeWalkDraft after), 212-312 + 498-518 (pendingRecovery notice with Retry + per-draft Discard), apps/web/src/lib/walk-drafts.ts; walk-tracking-view.tsx:470-489 (retry on reconnect)
current_ios: Walk input lives only in component state. RNFB `ref.set()` does not resolve until the server acks, so offline the button spins indefinitely and (since 捨棄 is disabled while saving and the Modal has no other exit) the user is stuck; killing the app loses the walk. No pending-walk notice on the walks home.
target: Persist each finalized walk to AsyncStorage before writing; remove after ack; show the web recovery notice on the walks home with Retry and Discard local draft; retry automatically once when the app returns to foreground/connectivity.
fix_plan: Add apps/ios/src/lib/walk-drafts.ts mirroring web (async AsyncStorage): keys `mango.walks.pending.v1.{uid}.{walkId}` and `mango.walks.discarded.v1.{uid}.{walkId}`; serialize Dates as ISO; functions storeWalkDraft/removeWalkDraft/discardWalkDraft/wasWalkDraftDiscarded/listWalkDrafts(uid) (getAllKeys + multiGet). In TRACK-1 save path: `await storeWalkDraft(input)` before createWalk, remove after. Race createWalk against a 15s timer → on timeout show saveFailed + Retry (keep draft). walks.tsx: on focus/AppState 'active' list drafts; render a card above the hero (cardSoft bg, hairline border, radius.lg, padding 16, 14pt ink) with t('Walks.core.pendingRecovery',{count}), Button t('Error.retry') (pill) that serially createWalk()s each draft then data.refresh(), and per-draft row `${petName} · ${startedAt.toLocaleString()}` + secondary Button t('Walks.core.discardDraft') guarded by the discardDraftTitle/Body Alert. No NetInfo dep needed: retry on AppState→active.

title: iOS createWalk is not idempotent: retry on a pre-minted id uses set() which rules reject as an update
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/firebase/walks.ts:102-112 (runTransaction: get, set only if !exists)
current_ios: createWalk always does `ref.set({... createdAt: serverTimestamp() })`. If the first write landed but the ack was lost (timeout/background), the retry becomes an update touching createdAt etc.; firestore.rules:345-348 only allow notes/photoURLs on update → permission-denied → user sees 存檔失敗 for a walk that is actually saved (and recovery would loop).
target: Same as web: transactional create-if-missing; treat existing doc as success.
fix_plan: In createWalk when input.walkId is set: `await db.runTransaction(async tx => { const snap = await tx.get(ref); if (!snap.exists) tx.set(ref, data); });` (RNFB snapshot.exists is a property in v21 / method in newer — match the version used elsewhere in apps/ios/src/lib). Keep the plain set path for walks without a pre-minted id (manual walk dialog).

title: endedAt is taken at save time (not stop time); missing startedAt silently fabricated
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:547-566 (endedAt frozen at stop; no startedAt → saveFailed)
current_ios: `startedAt: final.startedAt ?? new Date(), endedAt: new Date()` evaluated when 儲存 is tapped; minutes spent on the summary/notes screen inflate endedAt so endedAt-startedAt ≠ durationMin; a null startedAt produces a zero-length walk stamped now.
target: Freeze endedAt at stop; refuse to save without startedAt.
fix_plan: Build the CreateWalkInput in finishWalk (TRACK-1) with `endedAt: new Date()` at that moment and store in stoppedInputRef; if `!final.startedAt` set saveError t('Walks.core.saveFailed') and do not call createWalk.

title: Done screen recomputes from live props after onSaved refresh → today minutes double-count (goal-hit/percent jump)
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:221-225, 658-660 (session context snapshot: pet, streakDays, storedTodayMin, goalMin frozen at open); walks/page.tsx:418 (tracked sessions do not refresh until close), 839-846
current_ios: handleSave calls onSaved (= data.refresh) and, when autoPhotoShare is on, keeps the done screen mounted. After refresh todayMinBefore already contains the just-saved walk, so blendedMin = todayMinBefore + doneMin counts it twice; streakDays, goalMin and pet can also change underneath the open session.
target: Freeze session context at open; refresh the walks list on close.
fix_plan: In walk-tracking-view.tsx store `sessionRef.current = { pet, pets, streakDays, familyId, goalMin, todayMinBefore, weeklyAvgMin }` in the visible effect (127-140) and read every done/tracking computation from it instead of props. In walks.tsx move `data.refresh()` into onClose (`onClose={() => { setSessionOpen(false); void data.refresh(); }}`) and drop/no-op onSaved for tracked walks.

title: 3-hour runaway auto-stop + notice missing
web_ref: apps/web/src/lib/walk-tracking.ts:18, 150-156, 421-426 (RUNAWAY_CAP_MIN=180, autoStopped); walk-tracking-view.tsx:536-541, 955-962 (autoStoppedNotice card)
current_ios: No cap. In background mode a forgotten walk keeps background GPS (blue bar) running and duration growing without bound, inflating score/leaderboard and battery drain.
target: Auto-stop at 180 min, flag autoStopped, move to done screen and show the amber notice.
fix_plan: Service: `const RUNAWAY_CAP_MIN = 180;` in tick(): if durationMin >= cap && !state.autoStopped → stop location source/ticker (reuse stop()) and update({durationMin: 180, autoStopped: true}). Add `autoStopped?: boolean` to WalkTrackingState. View: `useEffect(() => { if (state.autoStopped && phase==='tracking') finishWalk(state); }, [state.autoStopped])`. Done screen: after headline render View {flexDirection:'row', gap:8, maxWidth:320, width:'100%', borderRadius:radius.sm, backgroundColor:colors.bellTint, padding:12} with `<AlertTriangle size={16} color={colors.brandDeep}/>` + Text 12pt t('Walks.core.autoStoppedNotice'). Note: the headless task can't run the ticker while suspended — also enforce the cap in stop()/resume using wall-clock (min(elapsed, 180)).

title: GPS status hints (weak signal / retrying / background gap) never shown during tracking
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/walks/walk-tracking-view.tsx:98-113, 748-760 (AlertTriangle + errWeak/errRetrying/errBackground, red for denied, brand-deep otherwise)
current_ios: errorKind only has permission_denied/position_unavailable, and position_unavailable is set only on start failure. Low-accuracy fixes are silently dropped with no 'weak signal' hint; in foreground-fallback mode backgrounding silently pauses time AND distance and the only copy is '背景暫停中…', which is only visible while the app is hidden.
